note: Counts from the dataset's own frames against the operator limits; the policy client clamps commands to the exact bounds and holds on an observed state outside them, with no recording tolerance.

rules.beyond_tolerance: past the bound by more than the recording tolerance; what the recording quality gate rejects
rules.outside: a commanded or observed value past the exact operator bound, beyond the 1e-06 storage slack of 32-bit floats
rules.pressing: a commanded or observed joint within 0.5 deg of an operator bound, on either side; the gripper only at its stroke
